narrative: Material PL2__M4EFC828 shows erratic demand (CV=0.622) with a statistically significant downward trend over the observation window. Lead times are moderately stable (CV=0.26) but span a wide range (0.32–7.88 days), contributing materially to demand-during-lead-time variance. A standard (r,Q) policy is recommended: it is simple to operate in SAP, provides a clear reorder trigger, and is robust to the moderate-variability lead-time environment. The storage capacity constraint caps the order quantity well below the unconstrained EOQ, making more frequent smaller replenishments necessary until capacity is expanded.

It provides a clear, SAP-native reorder trigger and is well-suited to moderate lead-time variability without requiring simulation or complex optimisation.
